purpose: Run one bounded current-f01e TP4/PIECEWISE/native-MTP1/F16 exact-4K sentinel against the clean same-image TP4/MTP0 PIECEWISE parent, with the same-topology TP4/MTP1 eager 4K result as mechanism evidence. This is not a depth expansion or publication packet.

tp4_mtp0_piecewise_result.scope: Only the clean exact 4K TP4/MTP0 PIECEWISE cell is a performance parent for this sentinel. Exact 8K is quarantined and supplies no parent or speed authority.

same_topology_mtp1_eager_evidence.authority: Mechanism, target-parity, baseline-quality, and topology precedent for this exact TP4/MTP1 tuple only; eager speed does not transfer to PIECEWISE.

exact_depth_contract.candidate_gate: The candidate exact request must pass every depth-helper gate and report cached_tokens=0.
exact_depth_contract.target_gate: All 128 candidate token IDs must exactly equal the clean same-image same-topology TP4/MTP0 PIECEWISE 4K parent. The pinned TP4/MTP1 eager 4K token array must first equal that target.

quality_contract.gate: Candidate must independently satisfy pass_all, baseline_match_all, seven passing exact cases, eight passing identical repeats with one unique hash, a passing 8K needle, exactly 24 true baseline comparisons, and cached_tokens=0 on all 16 quality requests. The needle is quality-only and creates no exact-8K graph cell.

topology_and_graph_contract.topology: TP4 only on ZE_AFFINITY_MASK=0,1,2,3; world_size=4/local_world_size=4 plus world ranks and local ranks 0-3 are required. No ONEAPI_DEVICE_SELECTOR and no TP1 oracle or authority are allowed.
topology_and_graph_contract.graph: enforce_eager=False; PIECEWISE size-one capture; mixed prefill-decode PIECEWISE marker and Graph capturing finished required; FULL decode capture forbidden.
topology_and_graph_contract.speculation: Resolved native method mtp, target model path, and num_spec_tokens=1 required. Drafted and accepted counter deltas are isolated around the exact 4K request and must both be positive, finite, and conserved.
topology_and_graph_contract.cache: Fresh dedicated ext4 cache root, prefix cache disabled, exact and every quality request cache-zero, and exactly rank_0_0 through rank_3_0 namespaces required.
topology_and_graph_contract.model: All 19 pinned model files must pass direct and ordinary verification before launch.
topology_and_graph_contract.cleanup: One fresh container/server lifetime, global EXIT/INT/TERM cleanup, container absent, port closed, no EngineCore/vLLM/llama server, and no render users at sealing.

current_f01e_tp4_mtp0_piecewise_8k.reason: The current-f01e TP4/MTP0 PIECEWISE 8K output fails same-image target parity. It is explicitly excluded from the runner, target set, graph cell, speed authority, and any descendant decision.

speculator_binding.type: native embedded Qwen MTP; no external draft model

terminal_classification.passed-quality-clean-sentinel: Exact 4K, isolated positive drafting/acceptance, exact TP4/MTP0 target equality, full objective and baseline quality, all-four graph/topology/cache/model identity, and cleanup all pass.
terminal_classification.quarantined-acceptance-failed: Exact 4K passes but isolated accepted speculation is not proven.
terminal_classification.quarantined-parent-parity-failed: Exact 4K passes but candidate tokens differ from the pinned TP4/MTP0 parent or the pinned MTP1 eager evidence no longer equals that target.
terminal_classification.quarantined-quality-failed: Exact 4K and mechanism/parity gates pass but the explicit full quality audit fails.
terminal_classification.quarantined-exact-depth-failed: The exact 4K request fails; retain only diagnostic evidence.
terminal_classification.unsupported: Only an exact-image log line explicitly classifying native MTP/speculation as unsupported.
terminal_classification.failed: Startup, identity, graph, topology, endpoint, model, rank cache, cleanup, or another non-explicit failure.

interpretation.pass_authority: A pass establishes only this current-f01e TP4/PIECEWISE/native-MTP1/F16 exact-4K sentinel as internal evidence pending separate human adjudication.
